name: My MariaDB Codespace
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y mariadb-server php php-mysql && curl -sSL https://ngrok-agent.s3.amazonaws.com/ngrok.asc | sudo tee /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/ngrok.asc >/dev/null && echo "deb https://ngrok-agent.s3.amazonaws.com bookworm main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ngrok.list >/dev/null && sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y ngrok && ngrok config add-authtoken '3GpfLEO2XisSA0rvQH9907x3cxI_7QHBcFwjHWViqjGrhiD13' && sudo service mariadb start && sudo mariadb -e "ALTER USER 'root'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'password'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;" && sudo mariadb -u root -ppassword < /workspaces/2026-Website/database_dump/schema.sql
postStartCommand: sudo service mariadb start && (pgrep -x ngrok >/dev/null || nohup ngrok tcp 3306 >/tmp/ngrok.log 2>&1 &)
